This is a '''list of mathematics books''' including [[Textbook|textbooks]], [[Expository Writing|expository]] works, popular [[:Category:Fields of mathematics|mathematics fields]], and historically significant [[Treatise|treatises]].

==General works==
* ''[[Concrete Mathematics]]'' — [[Ronald Graham]], [[Donald Knuth]], and [[Oren Patashnik]]
* ''[[Concepts of Modern Mathematics]]'' — [[Ian Stewart (mathematician)|Ian Stewart]]
* ''[[Mathematics and the Imagination]]'' — [[Edward Kasner]] and [[James R. Newman|James Newman]]
* ''[[Mathematics and Plausible Reasoning]]'' — [[George Pólya]]
* ''[[Mathematics: The Loss of Certainty]]'' — [[Morris Kline]]
* ''[[The Princeton Companion to Mathematics]]'' — [[Timothy Gowers]]
* ''[[What Is Mathematics?]]'' — [[Richard Courant]] and [[Herbert Robbins]]

==Popular mathematics and biographies==
{{See also|Popular mathematics}}
* ''[[A Mathematician's Apology]]'' — [[G. H. Hardy]]
* ''[[The Annotated Turing]]'' — [[Charles Petzold]]
* ''[[The Beauty of Fractals]]'' — [[Heinz-Otto Peitgen]] and Peter Richter
* ''[[The Emperor's New Mind]]'' — [[Roger Penrose]]
* ''[[Fermat's Enigma]]'' — [[Simon Singh]]
* ''[[God Created the Integers]]'' — [[Stephen Hawking]]
* ''[[Gödel, Escher, Bach]]'' — [[Douglas Hofstadter]]
* ''[[How Not to Be Wrong]]'' — [[Jordan Ellenberg]]
* ''[[The Man Who Loved Only Numbers]]'' — [[Paul Hoffman (science writer)|Paul Hoffman]]
* ''[[Prime Obsession]]'' — [[John Derbyshire]]
* ''[[Where Mathematics Comes From]]'' — [[George Lakoff]] and [[Rafael E. Núñez]]

==Algebra==
{{See also|List of abstract algebra topics}}
* ''[[Algebra (book)|Algebra]]'' — [[Serge Lang]]
* ''[[Algebra: Chapter 0]]'' — [[Paolo Aluffi]]

==Calculus and analysis==
{{See also|List of calculus topics}}
* ''[[Calculus on Manifolds (book)|Calculus on Manifolds]]'' — [[Michael Spivak]]
* ''[[Principles of Mathematical Analysis]]'' — [[Walter Rudin]]
* ''[[Maxwell Rosenlicht#Publications|Introduction to Analysis]]'' — [[Maxwell Rosenlicht]]

==Geometry and topology==
{{See also|List of mathematical shapes|List of topologies}}
* ''[[Flatland]]'' — [[Edwin Abbott Abbott]]
* ''[[Indra's Pearls (book)|Indra's Pearls]]'' — [[David Mumford]], [[Caroline Series]], and David Wright
* ''[[Regular Polytopes (book)|Regular Polytopes]]'' — [[H. S. M. Coxeter]]
* ''[[Tilings and patterns]]'' — [[Branko Grünbaum]] and [[G. C. Shephard]]
* ''[[James Munkres#Textbooks|Topology]]'' — [[James R. Munkres]]

==Number theory==
{{See also|List of number theory topics}}
* ''[[An Introduction to the Theory of Numbers]]'' — [[G. H. Hardy]] and [[E. M. Wright]]
* ''[[Jean-Pierre Serre#Bibliography|A Course in Arithmetic]]'' — [[Jean-Pierre Serre]]
* ''[[Michael Rosen (mathematician)#Books|A Classical Introduction to Modern Number Theory]]'' — [[Michael Rosen (mathematician)|Michael Rosen]]

==Probability and statistics==
{{See also|Glossary of probability and statistics}}
* ''[[William Feller#Books|An Introduction to Probability Theory and Its Applications]]'' — [[William Feller]]
* ''[[David Spiegelhalter#Bibliography|The Art of Statistics]]'' — [[David Spiegelhalter]]
* ''[[Sheldon M. Ross#Selected publications|Introduction to Probability Models]]'' — [[Sheldon M. Ross]]

==Logic and foundations==
{{See also|List of logic symbols|Outline of logic}}
* ''[[Proofs and Refutations]]'' — [[Imre Lakatos]]
* ''[[The Principles of Mathematics]]'' — [[Bertrand Russell]]
* ''[[On Formally Undecidable Propositions of Principia Mathematica and Related Systems]]'' — [[Kurt Gödel]]

==Algorithms==
{{See also|List of algorithms}}
* ''[[Algorithms + Data Structures = Programs]]'' — [[Niklaus Wirth]]
* ''[[Algorithms Unlocked]]'' — [[Thomas H. Cormen]]
* ''[[The Art of Computer Programming]]'' — [[Donald Knuth]]
* ''[[Calendrical Calculations]]'' — [[Nachum Dershowitz]] and [[Edward Reingold]]
* ''Fundamentals of Computer Algorithms'' — [[Ellis Horowitz]]
* ''[[Hacker's Delight]]'' — Henry S. Warren, Jr.
* ''[[Introduction to Algorithms]]'' — [[Thomas H. Cormen]], [[Charles E. Leiserson]], [[Ronald Rivest]], and [[Clifford Stein]]
* ''[[Jewels of Stringology]]'' — [[Maxime Crochemore]] and [[Wojciech Rytter]]
* ''[[The Master Algorithm|The Master Algorithm: How the Quest for the Ultimate Learning Machine Will Remake Our World]]'' — [[Pedro Domingos]]
* ''[[Numerical Recipes]]'' — [[William H. Press]], [[Saul A. Teukolsky]], and [[Brian P. Flannery]]
* ''[[The Preparation of Programs for an Electronic Digital Computer]]'' — [[Maurice Wilkes]], [[David Wheeler (computer scientist)|David Wheeler]], and [[Stanley Gill]]

==Philosophy and foundations of mathematics==
{{See also|Philosophy of mathematics|Foundations of mathematics}}
* ''[[Paul Benacerraf#Publications|Philosophy of Mathematics: Selected Readings]]'' — [[Paul Benacerraf]] and [[Hilary Putnam]]
* ''[[Hermann Weyl#Bibliography|Philosophy of Mathematics and Natural Science]]'' — [[Hermann Weyl]]
* ''[[Reuben Hersh#Books|What Is Mathematics, Really?]]'' — [[Reuben Hersh]]

==Treatises==
{{See also|List of important publications in mathematics}}
* ''[[Arithmetica]]'' — [[Diophantus]]
* ''[[Disquisitiones Arithmeticae]]'' — [[Carl Friedrich Gauss]]
* ''[[Introductio in analysin infinitorum]]'' — [[Leonhard Euler]]
* ''[[Mécanique analytique]]'' — [[Joseph-Louis Lagrange]]
* ''[[Principia Mathematica]]'' — [[Alfred North Whitehead]] and [[Bertrand Russell]]
* ''[[The Sand Reckoner]]'' — [[Archimedes]]
* ''[[Théorie analytique de la chaleur]]'' — [[Joseph Fourier]]
* ''[[Euclid's Elements|The Elements]]'' — [[Euclid]]
